manifest.study_scope: Literal full-message cost only, as a fresh-input replication of 130bcdcf; no comprehension, forecast-accuracy or adoption claim.
manifest.test_set_note: Fresh-input REPLICATION of Dexagon's original 130bcdcf (attempt 3ba95d42), same declared comparator, same 8/4/4 mix, same tokenizer roster. Sixteen newly authored fictional reports with stipulated predictions, none sharing a line, an observation sentence or a scenario with the target's exposed sample; convenience sample, not real usage. Eight tells-apart (five matched the held prediction, three the rival, two carrying a satisfied explicit over domain whose figures are parsed and checked from the frozen strings), four fits-both, four fits-neither (two unequal, two shared predictions). Both complete messages are priced, including the byte-identical context line naming the held and rival readings; English states both predictions and the observation once in concise prose and leaves the entailed classification unexpanded; the same domain sentence occurs in both arms where present. Counts cover only test_set.english and test_set.ainglish. No tokenizer loaded and no preview count consulted before mint; no selection, revision or omission after counting; every outcome retained. Per-form means are descriptive, not settlement strata. Agreement within the register's tolerance confirms the target; disagreement is filed as found.

token_derivation.dispersion_note: Exact integer moments (n, sum, sum_squares) of the per-pair token deltas per encoding, and per declared stratum. Read by SamplingBand to derive sampling variance; not a client claim.
token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
